PRINCIPLE: Tests should focus on a single behavior. RATIONALE: Single Arrange-Act-Assert improves root-cause identification. EVALUATION CRITERIA: Look for a single 'Act' operation and one assertion group. DECISION: The method performs exactly one method call (lista0.vazia()) and then a single assertion; there is one clear Arrange-Act-Assert block. VERDICT: compliant.

PRINCIPLE: Tests should not depend on other tests. RATIONALE: Ensures order-independence. EVALUATION CRITERIA: Look for setup/teardown or only local variables. DECISION: This test uses only local variables and does not reference shared mutable state in the visible code; no numbered test names. VERDICT: compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Coverage of Normal and Exceptional Flows
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Tests should cover happy and error scenarios. RATIONALE: Ensures robustness. EVALUATION CRITERIA: There should be at least two tests per method (happy + error) or explicit exception checks. DECISION: Only one test method exists and it only covers the happy/expected empty-list case; there is no test for error or exceptional flows. VERDICT: non-compliant.

PRINCIPLE: Tests should validate boundary values. RATIONALE: Many bugs occur at boundaries. EVALUATION CRITERIA: Look for empty, zero, negative, max values or 'edge' in names. DECISION: The method only checks a single typical case (empty list) and does not exercise related boundary scenarios (e.g., non-empty after insert). VERDICT: non-compliant.

PRINCIPLE: Tests should be self-contained and avoid duplication. RATIONALE: Improves maintainability. EVALUATION CRITERIA: Look for helper methods or, if very short and not repetitive, accept. DECISION: The test is short (<10 lines) and no duplication is visible in the single-method snippet; no helper methods needed for this simple case. VERDICT: compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Detailed Analysis of Size and Complexity
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Keep tests small with low cyclomatic complexity. RATIONALE: Easier to understand and less error-prone. EVALUATION CRITERIA: Methods <20 lines and no loops/conditionals. DECISION: The method is short (~5 lines) with straight-line logic, no loops or conditionals. VERDICT: compliant.

DECISION: This test has a single assertTrue on a boolean; it does not verify multiple properties (e.g., object not null plus state). VERDICT: non-compliant.
